summary: Tonix Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on June 8, 2026, to disclose a GPO agreement providing coverage for TONMYA for approximately 17 million U.S. commercially insured individuals, effective June 1, 2026, with standard utilization management criteria. TONMYA is also available under Medicaid in most states representing 75 million beneficiaries. The filing includes forward-looking statements. This is a routine commercial coverage agreement disclosure under Items 7.01 and 8.01, not a special situation transaction.
